text: {"lessons":["My account value fell from 99,036 to 93,662.90, so I should judge trades by how they serve my long-term goal, not assume buying will quickly grow savings.","I added to Stock A while also buying Stock C; I should watch concentration and avoid letting enthusiasm for a few stocks dominate my portfolio.","I should keep enough cash for flexibility and make buy, sell, or hold decisions based on a clear plan rather than reacting to short-term account changes."]}
